description.la: Quinque epistulae Thomae a Kempis: ad spiritualem profectum, de custodia sui, pro confortatione temptati, de conversione et perseverantia, de pia memoria defunctorum.
description.en-US: Five spiritual letters: on progress, on self-watchfulness, to console someone tempted, on conversion and perseverance, and on the pious remembrance of the dead. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Cinco cartas espirituais: sobre o progresso, a vigilância de si, a consolação do tentado, a conversão e perseverança, e a memória piedosa dos defuntos.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Epistulae, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR (Pohl 1918 volume).
sources.description: Chapters as Pohl divides them, with his upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings and isolated letters are often garbled; a chapter heading lost to OCR runs two chapters together.
